title: Caches
hints: Caches are declared in $GLOBALS['TYPO3_CONF_VARS']['SYS']['caching']['cacheConfigurations'] in typo3/sysext/core/Configuration/DefaultConfiguration.php: one entry per cache with a frontend class, a backend class, options and groups. Adding a cache means adding an entry there.
Inject a cache as a service with #[Autowire(service: 'cache.<name>')] on the constructor parameter rather than asking CacheManager for it at call time.

The 'core' cache is reserved for core PHP code. Pick or add a cache with the right frontend for the payload — VariableFrontend for data, PhpFrontend for generated code — and put it in the group whose flush semantics it belongs to.
Anything cached has to survive being flushed at any time; a cache is never the only place a value exists.
Cache behaviour is a wiring concern and is covered by functional tests.
